title: Profile (ship/profiles/<id>.toml): a named bundle of recipes plus setup
description: Written by the Ship track (W6). FleetLedger (W3, W10) reads profiles from the repo to validate --profile and to copy the profile's options from ships.toml into ship.toml [profile_options.<id>]. The file name must be <id>.toml.

tools.description: Recipe ids installed with the profile.

options.description: Values the profile needs from local config, e.g. a repo URL. Never committed with real values.

setup.description: Script relative to ship/profiles/, run as the agent user after the tools; options arrive as SHIPSHAPE_OPT_<NAME> variables.

toolId.description: A catalogue recipe id, or toolkit/recipe for a recipe from one of your toolkits (contracts/toolkit.md).

profileId.description: A catalogue profile id, or toolkit/profile for a profile from one of your toolkits (contracts/toolkit.md).

catalogueId.description: A recipe's or profile's own id, its file name: never a toolkit/ prefix.
